Marissa — reviewed Amarisoft's redline. Summary and recommended counters below. I attached a marked-up counter DPA (R-Malhotra_DPA_counters_20260303.pdf).

Summary of principal items and positions:
1) SCCs / transfers: We accept standard EU SCCs for EU-to-US transfers but cannot agree to any derogations that override our security controls. Recommend: include SCCs + an annex referencing our SCC implementation statement; carve out any contradictory derogations.
2) Data residency: We can commit to routing customer production data to us-west region for this account and document it in an appendix (operational commitment, not a separate contractual warranty).
3) Subprocessors: We will provide the latest subprocessor register (link in related_links) and commit to notify within 30 days of material additions.
4) Liability & caps: push to mutual cap tied to fees paid in last 12 months (standard). Reject language that removes consequential damage exclusions.
5) Audit rights: reasonable SOC2-based audit with vendor-supplied reports only (no on-site audits). We can offer supplemental questionnaires and SOC2 snapshot.

Additional notes:
- HIPAA: Amarisoft referenced HIPAA briefly — we do not sign BAAs for this product tier without additional controls. If HIPAA is required, escalate to Product for a compliance review and potential Dedicated/Private deployment.
- DPIA / GDPR: no blocking items; recommend adding a DPIA note if customer insists.

Next steps: I prepared counters and a clean version for signature if Amarisoft accepts. Please confirm that routing to DocuSign is OK once counters are accepted.
